ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; the visible fluke surface is composed of approximately 98 percent low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels, with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to edge-aligned specular highlights and focal scarring.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a measured pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth reaching roughly 15 percent of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude irregularity; the trailing edge is characterized by several deep, non-linear indentations and sharp, jagged serrations across both lobes, departing from a smooth linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Broadly convex leading edges that taper into acute, upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle scarring are localized on the distal tip of the right lobe and scattered along the upper trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe, forming a large semi-circular indentation adjacent to the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-orange biological epibionts (likely cyamids or stalked barnacles) attached to the extreme outer margin of the right fluke tip.
